question: We're leaving the settlement to hunt a level 1 White Lion for the first time. How do we prepare the hunt board and advance through movement and events until the showdown starts?

record.title: Hunt board setup and event sequence

record.layout: Printed page 61 has the board setup list. Page 62 starts Hunt Your Quarry at the bottom left and continues at the top center; the percentile explanation continues from bottom center to top right. The White Lion story event supplies its hunt placement diagram.
record.summary: Choose an available quarry and level, then use its story-event hunt diagram to set up the hunt board. Shuffle monster hunt events onto E spaces, fill other eligible spaces with basic hunt event cards, place the monster at its level marker and survivors at Start. Survivors take turns revealing and resolving the events in their current space before advancing one space toward the monster.
notes: The board has 13 spaces. Do not put basic hunt event cards on monster-event spaces, Start, Overwhelming Darkness, or Starvation. Place any hunt events triggered by gear according to their rules.

The event revealer reads and resolves the top card in the survivors' space. After completing it, archive that card and pass revealer duty to the next survivor. Resolve stacked events one at a time from top to bottom before moving, unless an event compels movement.
When no cards remain in the current space, move one space toward the monster and resolve the top event in the new space. The monster stays still unless an event moves it.

An empty entered space requires a hunt-event-table roll before moving again, unless instructed to skip spaces. The first landing on Overwhelming Darkness during each hunt triggers that story event instead of a hunt-table roll.

Moving into the monster's space ends the hunt and starts the showdown immediately. Do not resolve hunt events in its space except Starvation. The Starvation and Overwhelming Darkness event effects are not included here.

A basic Random Event card directs a 1d100 hunt-event-table roll: roll two d10s, designate tens and ones, and combine them. The pictured example uses tens 3 and ones 5 for event 35. This record provides the procedure, not the 100 event outcomes.

An event specifies who rolls. If no survivor is specified, the event revealer rolls and makes required random choices. Add gathering events only with the appropriate tools, once per hunt per event, on top of existing cards and outside Start, Overwhelming Darkness, and Starvation.

Related reviewed rules:
White Lion level 1 aftermath and rewards: On a standard level 1 White Lion victory, survivors gain +1 Hunt XP and eligible survivors gain +1 weapon proficiency level. The group gains 4 basic resources and 4 White Lion resources. The first time the group defeats a White Lion, add Catarium to the settlement locations. Apply proficiency eligibility rather than granting it to every survivor.

First settlement: development, crafting, and storage: During first-settlement development, spend endeavors at Lantern Hoard to build initial locations. Each location costs 1 endeavor: Bonesmith, Organ Grinder, and Skinnery can all be built with 3. Crafting spends the resources listed on the chosen location, archives those resource cards, and takes the crafted gear from the box. Record unspent resources and unworn gear in settlement storage before archiving their cards.

related_records.layout: The story-event Aftermath column gives level 1 victory and defeat. The right reward panel gives the level-specific resource counts and first-victory Catarium addition. Printed page 43 supplies proficiency eligibility.
related_records.summary: On a standard level 1 White Lion victory, survivors gain +1 Hunt XP and eligible survivors gain +1 weapon proficiency level. The group gains 4 basic resources and 4 White Lion resources. The first time the group defeats a White Lion, add Catarium to the settlement locations. Apply proficiency eligibility rather than granting it to every survivor.
notes: To gain the proficiency level, a survivor must have selected a weapon type and wounded a monster at least once with that type during the showdown, then be victorious. Without a selected type the survivor cannot gain proficiency unless a rule states otherwise.

The White Lion defeat instruction applies when the survivors lose: roll 1d10; on 6+, archive one jewelry gear of your choice. If survivors have no jewelry, nothing happens. Consult other applicable death/return rules separately.
The First Story has its own victory instructions and dead-survivor gear exception. Do not apply that exception to every later showdown.
These records cover the level 1 aftermath; level 2/3 rewards and Saga effects remain outside this unit.

related_records.summary: During first-settlement development, spend endeavors at Lantern Hoard to build initial locations. Each location costs 1 endeavor: Bonesmith, Organ Grinder, and Skinnery can all be built with 3. Crafting spends the resources listed on the chosen location, archives those resource cards, and takes the crafted gear from the box. Record unspent resources and unworn gear in settlement storage before archiving their cards.
notes: With fewer than 3 starting endeavors, choose which initial locations to build. Place built location cards below the settlement board. Each spent endeavor reduces the available total by 1.
If endeavors remain, an Organ Grinder permits Augury for 1 endeavor; follow its own rules. A birth triggers Principle: New Life. Those detailed outcomes are not included in this record.

The first-settlement overview permits innovating at Lantern Hoard by spending 1 endeavor and 3 resources, one bone, one organ, and one hide. Draw the top 2 innovation cards and choose 1 to add permanently. Full innovation and resource-substitution rules require their own reviewed sources.

A specific crafting recipe or crafted gear effect requires its location/gear source. This procedure does not establish the cost of an unreviewed recipe or whether a particular resource is a legal substitute.

Before departure, choose an available quarry and departing survivors, place acquired gear on their grids, update armor points, and apply departing bonuses. After First Story only White Lion is available until story events add more quarries.

Skip step 9 in the First Story settlement. Record unspent resources and unworn gear in storage and return their cards to the box; they may be retrieved later. Preserve the settlement record when putting the game away.
